set.StepText: Hear Thorgil's story.|Get the key from the tomte scavengers outside Thorgil's house, east over the bridge and to the south.|Search Thorgil's house for the hidden chest of jewels.|Return the chest to Thorgil in Audliten.|Choose your reward: whisper Thorgil what you want (magical power, strength, dexterity or sword).
set.SourceText: You seemed to have fared better with the tomtes than I have. Were you able to get the key from hem? My wife came by while you were gone and wanted to get something out of the chest, but I was able to distract her. Please, give me the key now.||||Would you like something that would add to you [magical power], your [strength], your [dexterity] or your skill with a [sword]? I can only give you one, so think carefully before you make your choice.
set.TargetText: Thank you. Now, this key will do me no good unless you were able to locate the chest of jewels in my house. Please give me the chest now.||||

set.StepText: Speak with Hulda the shield merchant in Audliten.|Speak with Edvard Averrson at the top of the guard tower across the bridge northeast of Audliten. Tell him [Thorgil] sent you. (whisper: Thorgil)|Slay Edigo at the wooden tomte tower near Thorgil's farm and obtain the tomte messages.|Give Edvard the tomte messages.|Seek out the tomte Smack in his fort southeast of the road between Audliten and the rope bridge, near the drakelings.|Give Thorgil the leg bone of Smack.|Choose your weapon: whisper Thorgil the kind you want ([sword], [axe], [hammer], [bow], [spear] or [staff]; Savages: [hand to hand slash]).
set.SourceText: So, Smack is behind all this mess, is he? I hope you were able to take care of him. If he's gone, perhaps I can move back to my farm and go back to the life I enjoyed. Please, give me proof that you were able to rid this world of Smack.||||||I have a few who would be able to turn this rather nice bone into a nice weapon for you. I just need to know who to send you to. Since there's only one bone, you can only pick one. Would you like a [sword], an [axe], a [hammer], a [bow], a [spear], or a [staff] for those that use magic?
set.TargetText: Hail and well met! You look like a (your class here) with a purpose for coming here. I don't think you seek a shield, but perhaps [information]?|Yes? Is there something I can do for you? I am rather busy, and I am also waiting for someone.||I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained.{next}It's good you brought these to me. They happen to be written in the ancient language of the tomtes, and my brother and I are experts at reading and writing it. It seems that Edigo has been following orders to drive the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas away and reclaim the land. I'm not surprised to see that the orders were issued by Smack. He has always been [eager to succeed]. A long time ago, Smack displeased <Player> and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into <Player>'s good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then <Player> will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]!|||
